name: PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk provides financial services in Indonesia. The company offers business and personal loans. It also offers savings accounts. The company was formerly known as PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Agroniaga Tbk and changed its name to PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk in September 2021. PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk was founded in 1989 and is based in Jakarta, Indonesia. PT Bank Raya Indonesia Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia (Persero) Tbk.
